title: Car pooling
statement: Trips are [passengers, from, to] along one road; passengers board at from and leave at to. Return whether a car of the given capacity can serve every trip.
hints: Only the moments when the load changes matter.
+n at from, −n at to; scan in time order (a difference array if positions are small).
complexity: O(n log n), or O(n + max position) with a difference array

solution.explanation: Events, not intervals: each trip is +n at its start and −n at its end; the load at any time is the prefix sum of events up to it. Checking every unit of time inside every trip would be O(n · length). This is Part 1's difference array, and the same sweep as meeting rooms.
